chapter.verse: Sanggam ki-itna kizomsuaksak un.
Zinleleng do ding awlmawh lokha kei un. A hang pen mi kimkhat in zinleleng dona ah theihloh kalin vanmite anletui a vakkha suak uh hi.
Thong sunga omte, amau tawh thong sungah a omkhawm bangin phawk un. Pumpi tawh om lai na hih mah bangun simmawh khelbawl a thuakte zong phawk un.
Vekpi kikal ah kitenna kithupi ngaihsut henla nupa omkhop vai ninbaanglo hita hen. A hang pen nulepa tatkhialhna a bawlte leh angkawmte Pasian in thukhen ding hi.
Na nuntakzia uh sum a deih lua nam ahilo dingin kikem unla na neih teng uh tawh lungkim un. A hang pen Pasian in, “Kong nusia ngeikei ding a, zong kong pampaih ngeikei ding hi,” ci hi.
Tua hangin hih bangin hangtak i gen thei hi: “Topa pen kei hong huhpa hi a, ka lau kei ding hi. Mihing in kei bang hong cih thei ahi hiam?”
Note' tunga Pasian' thu hong genkhia na makaite uh phawk un. Amaute' nuntak gamtatzia pana a gahkhia thu limtak ngaihsun unla amau' upna etteh un.
Jesu Khris pen zanni, tuni, leh a tawntungin a kibang ahi hi.

Hilhcianna lamdang a tuamtuamte' hangin lampialkha kei un. A hang pen Pasian' hehpihna thu tawh lungsim tha kidip ding hoih a, a zangte' tungah phattuamna a piangsak lo biakpiak ante tawh tha kidip ding hilo hi.
Eite in biakpiaktau khat i nei a, biakbuk sunga nasemte in tua tau tunga ante nek theih nading thu nei lo uh hi.
A hang pen siampi lianpenpa in siangtho mun sungah mawhphel biakpiak van dingin sisan lutpih a, tua sisan a kilakna ganhingte ii luangpum teng ahihleh giahphual pualam ah kihal hi.
Tua hi a, Jesu zong ama' sisan ngiat tawh mite a siansuah theih nadingin khua kongpi pualam ah sihna a thuak ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin giahphual pualam ama' kiangah pai-in ama' thuak mawhsakna va thuak ni.
A hang pen hih lai-ah khuapi a kipsuak i nei kei a, hong piang ding khuapi a zongte i hizaw hi.
Tua ahih manin Jesu' tungtawnin Pasian' kiangah ama' min a pulak muklekam gah ahi, pahtawi biakpiakna luui tawntung ni.
Thuhoih kibawlna leh kihuh kihopna awlmawh lokha kei un. A hang pen tua bang biakpiakna namte in Pasian lungdamsak hi.

Na makaite uh' thu mang unla amau' kiangah niamlut un. A hang pen Pasian' kiangah thulela a telgenkik dingte ahihna uh tawh amaute in nomau' nunna khate hong vil hong van uh ahi hi. Tua nasep, khuisa kawmin a sem hisak kei unla, lungdamtak a sem hisak un. Khuisa kawmin hong sep uhleh note' ading phattuamna om lo ding hi.
Ko' ading thu hong ngetsak un. A hang pen ka kitheihtawmna lungsim uh siangtho ahihlam ka kitel uh a, na khempeuh ah etlawmtak ka gamta nuam uh hi.
Note' kiangah kei hong kisawlkik baih theih nadingin thu nong ngetsak ding uh a ngatzaw thamin kong hanthawn hi.
Tu-in tawntung thuciamna sisan hangin tuute a cing Tuucing Lianpa a suak i Topa Jesu, misite' lakpan a hong tunpihkik, nopna lemna Pasian in

ama' deihna na zuih zawh nadingun note' tungah nahoih a kici khempeuh hong guan henla, Jesu Khris' tungtawnin ama' mai-ah a lungkimhuai thu eite' sungah hong sem ta hen. Tua Jesu in a tawntung a tawntungin minpha ngah ta hen. Amen.
Sanggamte aw, kong thapiakna kam hong tom gelh ka hih manin nong sansiam ding uh kong thum hi
I sanggampa Timothy hong suakta khin cih thu kong theisak nuam a, amah hong tun baih leh amah tawh kithuahin note' kiangah kong hawh ding uh hi.
Na makaite uh leh mi siangthote a vekun na hopihsak un. Italy pana hong paite in zong note hong hopih uh hi.
Note khempeuh' tungah hehpihna hong om ta hen.
